decisions.subject: ceramic_production
decisions.instruction: For an Edo blue-and-white artifact, use Arita/Hizen porcelain logic: cobalt underglaze, clear glaze, kiln-fired white porcelain body, and period-appropriate Japanese decorative handling.

decisions.subject: medium_boundary
decisions.instruction: For ceramic transformation, express brush-painted cobalt under clear glaze following the curved vessel surface; do not add paper fibers, key-block outlines, or print-registration artifacts.
